_comment: Criterion text -> expected access barrier (null = not a barrier). Most are verbatim from cached ClinicalTrials.gov T2D/CKD trials; the rest are written to probe a pattern's edge.

cases.text: Able to read and write English
English-speaking site staff
Ability to read and comprehend English or Spanish
Non-english speaking
Illiterate
Patients or caregivers with language barriers impairing appropriate conduct of the study protocol.
Must be able to complete English-language questionnaires
Participant is a fluent English speaker
In the opinion of the investigator, the participant is unable to read or understand English
Study site staff able to communicate with participants in English
Investigator must speak English
Participant or participant's representative is willing and able to provide written informed consent.
Able to understand and sign the informed consent form
Willing to attend weekly study visits for 12 weeks
Able to comply with frequent clinic visits
Willing to complete 14 in-person visits over 2 years
Willing to undergo two overnight stays in the clinical research unit
Able to remain in the clinical research unit for 5 consecutive days
Willing to be confined to the clinic for the inpatient period
Able to travel to the study site for all visits
Fasting overnight for at least 8 hours before the screening visit
Inpatient hospitalization for heart failure within 3 months prior to screening
The patient received blinded Investigational Product throughout the duration of the double-blind period up to the Week 104 visit
Stated willingness to comply with all study procedures and availability for the duration of the study.

Are willing to provide blood samples at enrollment and at subsequent clinical visits coinciding with standard of care follow-up, for up to 3 years as outlined in the study protocol and informed consent
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes for at least 10 years
access to the internet via a device with video and audio capability
ability to connect the patient's home blood glucose meter or CGM device - as well as insulin pump, if applicable - to an internet-capable device via Bluetooth or physical cable.
Must own a smartphone compatible with the study app
Willing and able to use an electronic diary (eDiary) daily
Able to download and use the study app
Has a valid email address and access to a computer
Currently taking metformin tablets at a stable dose
Implanted cardiac device (pacemaker or defibrillator)
Able to be contacted by the study team at follow-up
Has a caregiver who can supervise study drug administration
Must have a reliable study partner who can attend visits with the participant
Has reliable transportation to and from the study site
Must be accompanied by a responsible adult at each dosing visit
Lives alone without daily contact with a family member
female of childbearing potential or male with a female partner of childbearing potential unwilling to use a highly effective method of contraception.
If taking sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, the dose must be stable
